title: Tower equation for normalized finite Verdier comparisons
statement: theorem finite_tower_equation (F : Finite D l hl Ω X) : ∀ (E L M : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M) (K : Stage l Ω X E), HEq ((transition l Ω X L M k).map ((F.beta E L h).hom.app (op K)) ≫ (F.beta L M k).hom.app (op ((transition l Ω X E L h).obj K))) ((associator l Ω X E L M h k).hom.app ((F.datum E).dual.obj (op K)) ≫ (F.beta E M (h.trans k)).hom.app (op K) ≫ (F.datum M).dual.map ((associator l Ω X E L M h k).hom.app K).op)

proof.text: Apply the normalized rational Verdier unit/composition theorem to the finite scalar comparisons, identify coefficient inclusion identities/composites, and transport the canonical integral normalization to the recorded stage unitor/associator.
